_readme: Manual key-player override file -- highest precedence over every automated source (depth charts, injury reports, last starts). Edit, commit, push; the next board export picks it up. NFL keys are nflverse abbreviations (KC, DET); CFB keys are ESPN school names (Ohio State, Toledo); NHL keys are NHL abbreviations (TBL, NJD) and NBA keys are the board's codes (NY, GS). 'starter' corrects who QB1 is (NFL); 'alert' forces a NOT IN THE PRICE flag onto that team's card with your text shown verbatim, for any league -- for NHL this is the only goalie source. Delete an entry when resolved. Empty objects = no overrides.
